# Swiss Centro Medico

> Medical practice in Lugano, Switzerland: rheumatology, pain therapy, acupuncture, laser therapy and regenerative medicine, by one physician.

- Site: https://swisscentromedico.ch/
- Address: Via Alessandro Volta 1, 6900 Lugano
- Phone (calls): +41 91 921 04 27
- WhatsApp (messages): +41 78 605 33 72
- Email: dr.djordjevic@hin.ch
- Hours: Monday and Wednesday 08:00–16:30; Friday 08:00–13:30
- Languages on this site: Italian (default), German (/de/), French (/fr/), English (/en/)

Physician: Dott. med. univ. Zeljko Djordjevic, Specialist in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation FMH.
